title: fix(objectql): a cleared optional single-value select or lookup stores null, so a second unique clear is no longer refused 409 (#29277)
body:
domain:server#3 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQJdgarUjPLNgFBY67

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9CGzC168tQ8WTbgReWZVSo4)_
Fixes #29277

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：可选的单值选项、引用、文件字段（`select` / `radio` / `lookup` / `master_detail` / `user` / `tree` / `image` / `file` / `avatar` / `video` / `audio`）被清空（送来 `''`）时，服务端写入口改存 `null`，唯一与否都一样。哪些类型算在内由 `$empty` 规则表的 `null_only` 行加「存一个字符串」推出，不靠手写名单。唯一字段上第二条清空的记录不再被 `409 UNIQUE_VIOLATION` 拒绝，清空的记录也能被「为空」筛选到。
- **种子重放**：服务端把空白存成 `null` 的规则（三条：#20308 类型列、#29176 唯一文本、本卡单值列）移到 `@objectstack/core` 一处（`blankAsNullColumns` / `blankStorageForm`），写入口和种子加载器的重放比较都读它。种子里写 `''` 的行重放时不再每次被当作变更重写（主干上三条都会这样空转，已实测）。core 新增导出，所以声明改为 `Clause-②: yes (widening)`。
- **为什么改**：维护者裁决 #29346 选 B（记录 6579813296）。`''` 既不是选项值，也不是记录 id，本来就不该算一个值；`$empty` 规则表在这些类型上只认 `null` 为空，规则表不动。
- **风险与回滚**：这些字段清空后读回的是 `null` 而不是 `''`，按 `= ''` 查询的条件对新清空的记录不再命中。必填字段照旧拒收 `''`，`multiple: true` 字段不动，已存的 `''` 不迁移（迁移另立卡）。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/core/src/utils/blank-storage-form.ts`（规则本体）；`packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts` 的 `ReplayComparands.blankAsNull` 与 `isNoOpReplay`；`packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts` 的 `normalizeBlankTypedValues`；`packages/rest/src/rest-data-single-value-blank.test.ts`；`.changeset/29277-single-value-blank-null.md`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/rest-data-single-value-blank.test.ts`，预期 11 个测试全绿（主干上第二次清空是 409，`$empty` 查不到清空的记录）；`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/seed-blank-as-null-replay.integration.test.ts`，预期 2 个全绿（主干上重放 `totalUpdated` 为 4）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The ruling.** Maintainer ruling B on #29346 (record 6579813296): the write door stores `''` as `null` on every optional column whose type sits on the `$empty` table's `null_only` row and is string-stored single-value. The `$empty` table is unchanged; `required` keeps refusing `''`; a blank on insert takes a declared `defaultValue`; cleaning stored `''` is a separate migrate-lane card.
- **The seam.** `normalizeBlankTypedValues` (`packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts`), the engine's existing blank write door: `ObjectQL.insert()` / `insertMany()` / `update()` (by id and by predicate) and the dry run `validate()` apply it before anything else reads the payload, and every REST, batch, upsert and import door reaches the engine through those methods. `engine.ts` is not touched.
- **The new arm.** The door's blank-as-null rule is now ONE function in `@objectstack/core` (`packages/core/src/utils/blank-storage-form.ts`): `blankAsNullColumns(objectSchema)` maps each column to its reach, `'blank'` (any `isMissing` blank: the #20308 typed arm, `NON_TEXT_STORED_VALUE_TYPES`, unchanged) or `'empty'` (exactly `''`), and `blankStorageForm(value, reach)` gives the stored form. An `'empty'` column is not `required: true`, not a lifecycle column the engine owns (`ENGINE_LIFECYCLE_COLUMNS`, which the validator's `SKIP_FIELDS` now reads), and EITHER text-like and unique-covered (#29176, unchanged) OR on the `$empty` table's `null_only` row (`expandEmptyOperator(def).arm`, read first, so a `multiple: true` column, the `multi_value` row of #29343, is out) AND storing one string (`ONE_STRING_STORED_TYPES`). `normalizeBlankTypedValues` consumes it and keeps no arm logic of its own.
- **The seed replay (round 3).** `isNoOpReplay` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts`) compared a seed `''` literally with the stored `null`, so every seed row writing `''` on a blank-as-null column read as changed and was rewritten on each replay. A new replay comparand `ReplayComparands.blankAsNull` (built once per dataset from the definition by `blankAsNullColumns`, beside `temporal` and `masked`) puts the SEED side in its stored form before `seedValueEquals`. There is no blanket `'' == null`: on a column the door keeps `''` (plain text), a seed `''` against a stored `null` is still a change (pinned). **Pre-existing on main:** measured on head `071872b7` (where the #20308 and #29176 arm code and the seed loader are byte-identical to `origin/main`), a replay of one `''` per arm rewrote 4 of 4 rows: the number, date and unique-text rows churned before this PR, and the select row is this PR's arm. All three arms are now pinned.
- **The storage-shape set.** The spec has no predicate for "stores one string", so `ONE_STRING_STORED_TYPES` is stated once, in core, from the spec's classes: `SINGLE_OPTION_TYPES` (an option code), `REFERENCE_VALUE_TYPES` (a record id), `FILE_REFERENCE_TYPES` (an opaque `sys_file` id). A pin ties it to the table: every `FieldType` whose expansion is `null_only` and that the typed arm does not own must sit in exactly one of that set, `STRUCTURED_JSON_TYPES` or `COMPUTED_VALUE_TYPES`, so a type that joins the row unclassified turns the pin red.
- **Left out, measured on SQLite through the engine** (non-blank value, then `''` twice, on a unique column): `json`, `composite`, `record`, `location`, `address`, `repeater`, `vector` store an object or an array (`{"a":1}`, `[0.1,0.2]`), so `''` is not a blank of their shape; `formula` is never stored; `autonumber` is issued by the engine on insert whatever the caller sent (`A-1`, `A-2`, `A-3` for a value, `''`, `''`). The file references stored one string id (JSON-encoded on SQL: `"img_1"`) and a second `''` was refused `DUPLICATE_RECORD`, so they join.
- **Edges.** Exactly `''`: whitespace stays a value (on a reference column the referential-integrity check refuses it, before and after). Lifecycle columns (`created_by`, `updated_by`) are never rewritten. `owner_id` (an injected optional lookup) is in the set; the security middleware already reads `owner_id` `''` and `null` as one (`security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts`, the `row.owner_id == null || row.owner_id === ''` checks), so its answer does not move.
- **New export (Clause-② widening).** `@objectstack/core` exports `blankAsNullColumns`, `blankStorageForm`, `ENGINE_LIFECYCLE_COLUMNS` and the types `BlankAsNullReach` / `BlankAsNullFieldDef`. The changeset adds `@objectstack/core` and `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` patch entries. No spec edit.
- **The fence.** Neither the `BOUNDED_STRING_FIELD_TYPES` string arm (#29241) nor the select value-shape check (#29244) is touched.
- **Pending changeset corrected.** `.changeset/29176-optional-unique-blank-null.md` (unreleased) said `select` / `lookup` columns keep storing `''`. This PR makes that false in the same release, so the sentence now says text columns keep `''` and points at this change. That is a deliberate correction of another PR's pending changeset, so `check-empty-changeset` reports it (see Verification).

## Why

`''` is neither an option code nor a record id. Stored as sent, it was a value to SQL `UNIQUE` (the second cleared record on a unique column was refused 409) and not empty to `$empty`, whose ruled table reads only `null` as empty on these types. The formula matcher, `having` and CEL `isBlank` already read `''` as empty, so the SQL face now agrees with them for every newly cleared row.

## Tests

New files:

- `packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.single-value-blank.test.ts` (8 tests): the population derived from `FieldType` and the table, with every untyped `null_only` type classified into exactly one storage class; the joined set (11 types) and the left-out set (9 types) pinned; the left-out types keep `''`; `''` becomes `null` on every optional member, unique or not; `required` (with and without a `defaultValue`) keeps `''`; `multiple: true` is the `multi_value` row and keeps `''`; lifecycle columns untouched; whitespace and non-blank values untouched; purity.
- `packages/core/src/utils/blank-storage-form.test.ts` (7 tests): each arm's reach (typed incl. required and lifecycle `created_at`; unique text by field and by index, plain text and `password` out; one-string `select` / `lookup` / `image` in, required / `multiple: true` / `json` / `autonumber` / `created_by` out); the lifecycle list; an unresolvable definition declares none; `blankStorageForm` per reach.
- `packages/runtime/src/seed-blank-as-null-replay.integration.test.ts` (2 tests), real `ObjectQL` + SQLite `SqlDriver` + `SeedLoaderService`: one seed `''` per arm (number, date, unique text, select) lands `null` and a replay skips all four (`totalUpdated: 0`, `totalSkipped: 4`); control: a plain text column stored `null` and reseeded `''` is still updated and stores `''`.
- `packages/rest/src/rest-data-single-value-blank.test.ts` (11 tests), real `ObjectQL` + SQLite `SqlDriver` + `RestServer` routes, physical column read past the engine: POST `''` on all eleven joined types stores NULL; PATCH clear on all eleven; unique `select` + `lookup` created `''` twice and cleared by PATCH twice both land; a unique `image` created `''` twice both land; a declared unique-index member; batch create and `createMany`; a real duplicate still `409 UNIQUE_VIOLATION`; required `select` / `lookup` still `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` / `required` (one with a `defaultValue`); a blank on insert takes the declared `defaultValue` exactly as `null` does; the `$empty` pin: on a row written `''` past the engine, `$empty: true` answers only the newly cleared row, `$empty: false` answers the legacy `''` row and the valued row, `= ''` answers only the legacy row.

Forced edits to existing tests (each pinned that a `select` / `lookup` `''` stays `''`, which the ruling reverses):

- `packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.blank-typed-value.test.ts`: the string-stored control list drops the option and reference types (they keep their "not typed" assertion).
- `packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.optional-unique-blank.test.ts`: the "other string-stored" control is now `autonumber` only.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-optional-unique-blank-door.test.ts`: the unique `pick` (select) / `ref` (lookup) columns move from the kept-`''` set to the covered-`null` set.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-blank-typed-value-door.test.ts` and `packages/rest/src/rest-data-blank-typed-value.test.ts`: the `c_lookup` / `c_select` controls now expect `null`; `c_text` still `''`.

Round 3 forced edits (no expectation changed):

- `packages/runtime/src/seed-blank-reference-real-driver.integration.test.ts`: the comment at the `loan-empty` assertion said the insert door "does not null" a blank lookup; it now says an optional lookup's `''` is stored as `null` since #29277 and the replay compares it in that form. Its expectations (`totalUpdated: 0`, `totalSkipped: 6`) are unchanged and now pass.
- `packages/objectql/src/federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts`: four VOCABULARY rows (`validation/record-validator.ts#<module> :: created_at / created_by / updated_at / updated_by`) deleted, as the census asks when a seam use leaves the source: the lifecycle names moved to core's `ENGINE_LIFECYCLE_COLUMNS`.

<details><summary>Red on main, green on head</summary>

The two new files were committed first (`0acdf485`) and run against `origin/main` `96fb7b5d`'s objectql build: rest `Tests 9 failed | 2 passed (11)` (POST stored `''`; unique `[201, 409]` on create, `[200, 409]` on PATCH and the index member; batch `[true, false]`; defaults not applied; `$empty: true` answered `[]`), unit `Tests 2 failed | 5 passed (7)`. Two of those rest reds were my own fixture faults (a `tree` value naming no record of its object, a whitespace lookup id the referential-integrity check refuses), fixed in `a71af048`; the whitespace case moved to the unit file. On head: rest 11/11, unit 8/8.

</details>

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Clause-②: yes (widening).** `@objectstack/core` gains exports (round 3, the seat's ruling 6582252856). Measured: no door refuses anything it accepted. `''` on every ruled type was accepted (201 / 200) on base and is on head; required refusals are identical on both. A second unique clear moves from 409 to 201, the same direction #29176 declared `no`.
- **Read shape.** A field cleared from now on reads `null`, not `''`, and matches `$empty: true`, `$null: true` and `= null`; it no longer matches `= ''` (the changeset says so). Stored `''` rows are not migrated and keep their old answers; the migrate-lane card cleans them.
- **File reference types join** (seat 3's round-2 reading of ruling B, comment 6581612131: the rule is stated by the table plus the storage shape). A `multiple: true` file or image column is the `multi_value` row and stays out (#29343).
- **Not measured:** PostgreSQL, MySQL (same knex path), MongoDB (the `mongod` download is 403 in this container).
